title: Anari Energy — verified hot-climate and monsoon operating observations
license: CC BY 4.0 — free to cite with attribution to Anari Energy
citation: Anari Energy (2026). Verified hot-climate and monsoon operating observations. https://www.anaricharge.com/data/hot-climate-observations-2026.json
method: Field observations reported by commissioning engineers at handover and after the first operating season. Each entry states what was measured and what was not.

observations.observed: Rated output sustained at nameplate power
observations.hardware: Vulco 160 kW, two-gun and three-gun (2 DC + 1 AC Type 2) configurations
observations.not_measured: Continuous derating curve; per-degree output; long-term capacity fade

observations.observed: Rated output sustained at nameplate power
observations.hardware: Pales 240 kW (site also operates 2 × 180 kW units)
observations.not_measured: Humidity-adjusted derating; connector thermal behaviour under load

observations.observed: Zero weather-related downtime across the first monsoon quarter
observations.not_measured: Rainfall volume; flooding depth; component-level failure rates

known_gaps: No continuous derating curve published — we do not have enough logged sensor data to publish one honestly
No multi-year capacity fade data for DC units in these climates
Observations are per-site reports, not controlled experiments
